name: Smith River (Permit)
gaugeName: Smith bl Eagle Creek nr Fort Logan
blurb: Montana's only permit-lottery river. 59 canyon miles, 4–5 days, zero cell service.

sections.notes: Launch requires an FWP permit. Below ~150 cfs expect to drag boats.

distanceEvidence.sourceName: Montana FWP Smith River Recreation Management Plan (2026), p. 19
distanceEvidence.note: The 2026 FWP management plan identifies Camp Baker at mile 0 and Eden Bridge at mile 58.8. This is the permitted trip length, not a measurement from the approximate map markers.
